class.name: SpeechModel
class.brief_description: A Resource that holds a path to a Vosk Speech Model.
class.description: A Speech Model Resource that represents a Vosk speech recognition model. It allows you to load and manage the model for speech recognition tasks. You can download Vosk language models from [url=https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models]This Website[/url]. After downloading, you can set the model path in the SpeechModel Resource to point to the directory containing the model files. The model path should be a valid directory path where the Vosk model is located.
